worldcombat.skill.fellstinger.summary: A short, precise sting; felling the target with it sharply raises the user's Attack.
worldcombat.skill.fellstinger.descriptio: A short forward lunge: the first enemy it meets in its path takes about %1$s physical damage. It advances up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s-block collision radius, stopping on a body or an obstacle (an ally in the way halts it without taking damage). Knocking the target out with this blow raises the user's Attack by %5$s stages (stat stages, up to +6).
